title: Nicer Than Expected
text: Nicer Than Expected. These can koozies are nicer than expected. They have a furry texture to them which makes it even more fun! I ordered these for an upcoming girls trip. I used a paint marker and put everyone's initial on it. Because it was furry, it took a second application of paint, but they turned out cute. I am very happy with them.
